description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the capacity of secondary and high school teachers in Battambang Province, as well as new teachers from Battambang Teacher Education College (BTEC), to effectively teach and implement STEM education in their schools.

activity-date.narrative: The project was scheduled to start in early October 2025. The commencement was adjusted to mid-October 2025 to allow sufficient time for contract processing and approval, resulting in activities beginning one week prior to the training date.

sector.narrative: The project purpose was achieved. The project successfully strengthened the capacity of secondary and highschool teachers from Battambang Province and BTEC to implement STEM education, although the final number of participants was slightly lower than originally planned. The project targeted 207 teachers (107 newly teacher from BTEC and 100 in service teacher from Battambang), and was able to train 199 teachers in total (104 female, 95 male), consisting of 52 new teachers from BTEC (30 female,22 male) and 147 in service teachers from Battambang ( 74 female, 73 male).
